text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Feeeel the reeelief...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from my first shrine visit of the year—I heard some kind of cry coming from the side of the road...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Feeeel the reeelieeeef...
choice_data_list: Inside the snow hut... is Ms. Anshinzawa?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*!! <username>-san!?
The real deal!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, please help meee~~!
At this rate, I'm gonna freeze to deaaath~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
*phew*! What a refresher~~~~~☆
New Year's really ain't complete without amazake and osechi♪
choice_data_list: Why were you in a place like that?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya see~ to hype things up for the New Year,
I gave Master a nice little jab right in the rear, and—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I messed up big time and got kicked out~!
Tee-hee☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Woah~! Stop acting like I screw up
every single time, okay~~??
...*hic*!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hey, even I can pull off a poke-tastic critical success every once in a while, ya know~?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Look~, I'll prove it to you right now☆
Think of it as a New Year's gift~~~♪ Deal?
choice_data_list: I'll pass on getting treated by someone who's drunk!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I scrambled to put some distance between us――
only to be cut off from behind!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Nooow theeeen~♪
Tell Mama which secret pressure point you want poked, hmm~??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now that it's come to this, I just have to brace myself...!
choice_data_list: A-A pressure point that improves health, please...
Hit the pressure point that makes you smarter!
Is there a pressure point that makes you more charming?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Okey-doke☆
Ready, and... *hic*—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Stab stab and poke!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bullseye needle poke, massive success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Power surged through my entire body, and my mind cleared up instantly—this was a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
*hic*……
How's that, huh~? Had enough yet~~~??

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ........*mumble mumble*... *snooooore*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying her to the sofa as she snored on the floor,
I found myself wondering if she actually gives better treatments
when she's drunk...
